notes: SIMDVault (src/SIMDVault.sol) is the only contract the factory deploys for this launch; its constructor takes no arguments and creates and permanently links the three other application contracts, JobsVault, CompensationVault and HolderRewards, exposing them as the immutable getters jobsVault(), compensationVault() and holderRewards(). Deploying separate copies of the children would not be linked to the vault and is intentionally not part of this manifest. No owner, admin, proxy, upgrade or pause exists, so there is no $owner argument. Every fixed address is a compile-time constant in src/Network.sol: IMD 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127, Identity.md Intake 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82, launch factory 0x9c9d2fcb75c2c132c0ac0c42df3819a42347265e, Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951, dev and marketing wallet 0xdfa1f1f6feaa04f7874eff0b7754b7ffaebd8bc0, burn destination 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD. The constructor calls no existing chain contract, so it deploys on an empty chain. The dev wallet has exactly two one-time powers: launch(bytes) pays Intake priceOf("launch.open@launch-1", IMD) from the vault's own IMD so the vault becomes the launch's requester, and bindLaunch(uint64, address) stores the launch number and token for good after checking factory.positionOf(launchNumber).requester == vault, passing the token (and pool key) to the children. distribute() is callable by anyone at most every 7 days after binding: it tries factory.claimFees inside try/catch, splits the whole IMD balance 40% HolderRewards, 25.72% JobsVault, 17.14% dev, 17.14% marketing, burns the vault's whole balance of the launched token and forwards any native ETH to marketing. HolderRewards opens a weekly epoch per deposit, requests the holder Merkle root through Intake oracle.request@oracle-1, accepts answers only from Intake carrying an attestation signed by the swarm oracle signer constant 0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982, caps claims at each epoch's pot and rolls pot - claimed into the current epoch after 28 days. JobsVault lets a wallet holding at least 1,000,000 launched tokens open one Identity.md job per 24 hours, paid from its own IMD. CompensationVault holds the fixed migration refund list (Merkle root 0xe84256f66c03a4565c29addd32238495f1a0d5dda8c618e5f81ff8637c296347, total weight 201084680772174552329559308, 62 wallets), buys back the launched token through the PoolManager in at most ten 10% tranches no sooner than 30 minutes after binding and 10 minutes apart, each swap bounded to a 1.5% sqrt-price band around an earlier reference price (partial fills are not tranches; after 3 days anyone can end the buyback so the airdrop always opens), then airdrops the acquired tokens pro rata once per listed wallet. After deployment the vault must be funded with IMD for the launch price; deployment itself sends no ETH and makes no initialization call.
